risks.label: Industrial Economy Weakness

risks.label: De Minimis Exemption Impact
risks.evidence: The removal of the de minimis exemption has created significant challenges for small exporters and shippers.

risks.label: International Export Pressure
risks.evidence: International export volumes declined, particularly on the China to U.S. lane, despite efforts to pivot to other regions.

risks.label: Margin Compression
risks.evidence: At FedEx Freight, revenue per shipment declined 1%, driven by lower revenue per hundredweight and lower fuel surcharges.

wins.label: Strong Q1 Results
wins.evidence: Revenue was up 3% year-over-year, driven by strength across our U.S. domestic package services. We achieved our targeted $200 million in transformation-related savings and grew adjusted operating income by 7%.

wins.label: Network 2.0 Progress
wins.evidence: Q1 also marked our best new business quarter in Europe in the last 2 years. Approximately 360 stations have been optimized across the U.S. and Canada, enabling nearly 3 million in average daily volume flowing through Network 2.0 optimized operations.

wins.label: International Export Pivot
wins.evidence: Knowing our strongest international lane would be under pressure. We pivoted the commercial team, and they have done a tremendous job capturing demand out of Southeast Asia and Europe.

wins.label: Health Care Growth
wins.evidence: We grew our U.S. domestic small business revenue by more than 10% year-over-year. This was fueled by focused and targeted sales execution and a close alignment between our sales and our operations teams.

wins.label: Airfreight Performance
wins.evidence: We are a relatively small market share participant from a global airfreight perspective. We are being selective and really focused on premium freight.

risks.label: Global Trade Headwind
risks.evidence: Significant volatility and uncertainty around the global trade environment. $1 billion headwind due to the global trade environment.

risks.label: U.S. Postal Service Contract Expiration
risks.evidence: The expiration of the Postal Service contract at the end of this month. $160 million headwind to adjusted operating income.

risks.label: Freight Weakness
risks.evidence: Due to the evolving trade environment in the quarter, we experienced a material headwind on our Asia to U.S. lane, largely from China outbound, driving most of the $150 million headwind to adjusted operating income.

risks.label: Industrial Economy Slowdown
risks.evidence: Weakness in the industrial economy and excess capacity in the truckload market continue to pressure our results.

risks.label: De Minis Changes
risks.evidence: With the full removal of the de minimis exemption in the United States late last month, we have been working closely with our customers, helping them maintain effective and efficient access to the vital U.S. market.
